headline: Easy breeding chain: Warsect
title: Easy Warsect Breeding Chain in Palworld | 3 Steps From Easy Pals | Palworld Breeding Guide
video_script: Three breeds from easy Pals, and Warsect is yours. Let's go. Step one: breed Lovander with Vanwyrm to get Valentail. Step two: breed that Valentail with Bushi to get Tarantriss. Step three: breed Tarantriss with Wumpo, and the egg hatches into Warsect! Every step is checked against Palworld one point zero breeding data. Put each pair on the Breeding Farm with a cake. Which Pal should I chain next? Comment below!
description: Easy 3-step Palworld 1.0 breeding chain to Warsect: Lovander + Vanwyrm = Valentail, Valentail + Bushi = Tarantriss, Tarantriss + Wumpo = Warsect. Each step verified on PalBreedCalc and with the breeding formula from PinDrop's combi ranks.
